BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to discrimination in public schools; and adding anew section to chapter 28A.640 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.640RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The office of the superintendent of public instruction shall haveauthority to monitor, investigate, and prepare complaints for victimsof discrimination in public schools based on state laws prohibitingdiscrimination including sex, race, creed, color, national origin,marital status, sexual orientation as defined in RCW 49.60.040, age, orthe presence of any sensory, mental, or physical disability or the useof a trained dog guide or service animal by a person with a disability,as well as federal laws prohibiting discrimination including Title VIof the civil rights act of 1964, as amended (42 U.S.C. Secs. 2000d etseq.), Title IX of the education amendments of 1972, as amended (20U.S.C. Secs. 1681 et seq.), section 504 of the rehabilitation act of1973, as amended (29 U.S.C. Sec. 794), the age discrimination act of1975, as amended (42 U.S.C. Secs. 6101 et seq.), and the boy scouts of p. 1 SB 6800America equal access act of 2001 (20 U.S.C. Sec. 7905). Complaintsprepared by the office of the superintendent of public instructionshall be submitted to the human rights commission for enforcement.
